senses.gloss: (cmp. טְרַק II) to lock up, obstruct; (neut. v.) to be stopped up, (trnsf.) to be deaf, silent. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 8 מהולתך טַרְשָׁא וכ׳, v. חֲרַשׁ; Y’lamd. to Lev. XXVII, end and to Num. XXI, 1 (quot. in Ar.).—
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> [read:] <he>ט׳ סלקית וט׳ נחתית</he> (not <cite ref="I00563"><he>טמשא</he></cite>) silent do I go up (to Jerusalem) and silent do I go down.
